decisions.D1: Comparative evaluation of contextual label reliability, with a compact critique of label limits.
decisions.D2: M1 original best-class set; M2 contextual feasibility then original label; M3 same feasibility then contextual label. Retain all ties.
decisions.D3: Separate practical shortlist: every available trajectory completes within the horizon and satisfies any budget; remove Pareto-dominated candidates within that strict feasible set before selecting its best contextual class.
decisions.D4: Documented motivation, explicitly assumed outage schedule; add start halfway through the first supply window.
decisions.D5: Mean remains the main imputation; compare median and omission using identical masks and frozen calibration.
decisions.D6: BERT/SQuAD primary; complete compact control on ShuffleNet-v2/CIFAR-100 from the same Zeus/V100 archive.
decisions.D7: Complete the scientific revision before choosing the target journal.

secondary_task.quality_eligibility: All available matched learning trajectories must reach the published target. Retain failed trajectories and withhold completed-task means and labels for their configurations.
secondary_task.calibration: Frozen quantiles of the configuration means satisfying the quality condition, separately from BERT/SQuAD.
secondary_task.budget: Same multipliers of the task-specific median reference mean GPU energy.
secondary_task.recovery: Same declared surrogate overheads as BERT; sensitivity assumptions, not measured ShuffleNet checkpoint costs.

strict_shortlist: Use observed/reconstructed complete information only; no imputed value certifies admissibility. Empty shortlists are valid outcomes.
independence: Learning trajectories are reused across power limits; neither reconstructed rows nor unequal repeat counts support a common probabilistic guarantee.
